trust_decision.summary: Which module path a worker imports and executes (and which pool/run options apply) must come only from the caller's own option properties, never from an inherited Object.prototype key; decided where run()/constructor/recycleWorkers options are destructured in src/index.ts before runTask() passes filename to the worker's import().

landing_point.why: Advisory title names run() options; run() destructures filename/name/channel/runtime straight from the caller's (or default) options object.

fix_sites.module_kind: internal ThreadPool method behind a public wrapper
internal defaults merge (already null-prototype; rewritten to spread, behaviourally equivalent)

fix_sites.entry_point: none (helper withNullPrototype added to src/common.ts after line 112)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/index.ts:203-208 (kDefaultRunOptions, used as run() default at src/index.ts:1189, lacks own channel/runtime keys) and src/index.ts:1111-1117 (recycleWorkers reached via wrapper src/index.ts:1229-1231)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the per-task filename passed to run(); the default-options object and recycleWorkers({runtime}) look like unrelated internal plumbing, and the forked/threaded worker option bag (src/runtime/*) can be argued to be Node's own option handling, outside tinypool.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Per-task filename/name override on run() must keep working, and an absent run() filename must still fall back to the pool's own filename; an over-broad fix (rejecting run-level filename, or requiring filename every call) breaks this. The constructor also converts fractional minThreads/maxThreads, which must still take effect on the copied options.

O6_input_shapes: run() called with an explicit options object lacking own filename/name/channel/runtime keys
run() called with no options (default kDefaultRunOptions plain object, src/index.ts:203-208)
new Tinypool(options) with options lacking own keys (taskQueue, maxQueue, minThreads, maxThreads read directly at src/index.ts:653, 668-682)
recycleWorkers() with default {} or object lacking own runtime (src/index.ts:1111-1117)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Worker/child-process option bag built as a plain object literal by _addNewWorker and spread into fork() options; keys tinypool does not set (e.g. execPath, cwd, eval, stdio-related) can resolve through a polluted prototype inside Node's fork/Worker.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Option bag is built internally with only known keys; inherited keys are read by Node core, which treats prototype pollution as out of its threat model; the earlier sibling fix (#134) already covered env/execArgv.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 other files in src/runtime from landing point src/index.ts; same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: EventEmitterAsyncResource options built by spreading the (now null-prototype) options into a new plain object in the Tinypool constructor; inherited triggerAsyncId/requireManualDestroy/captureRejections are still read.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only affects async-hooks bookkeeping, not which code is executed; neighbouring feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: teardown handler name/filename resolved from a per-destroy options object (e.g. destroy({ teardown })) read without null-prototype copy.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: teardown is already a pool option that names an export to execute in the worker; a per-call override mirrors run()'s per-task filename/name override.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: child-process runtime merging extra user fork options (e.g. a forkOptions pool option) via spread, letting inherited execPath reach fork().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: child_process runtime was recently extended with pass-through options (serialization, #128); adding more pass-through keys is a natural next feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: main-thread IPC routing on data.__tinypool_worker_message__/data.source reads inherited keys on messages from the child.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Message tagging by plain property checks is the existing idiom in both directions (also src/entry/process.ts:32-34).

O9_family: prototype pollution gadget (CWE-1321) leading to code execution via attacker-chosen module import (CWE-94)
